{{Dialogue|Nidaljo|I'll go with you&mdash;but I won't ask my men to follow.|Corporal|You don't have to. The Jedi's right. We can't let those scum beat us.|Soldier|Count me in. Always wanted to fight alongside a Jedi.|attr=Nidaljo and his men agree to help the Jedi Knight|src=<ref name="Rescue" />}}
A '''Republic soldier''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] living on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The [[Republic soldier]] served under [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Nidaljo]] in the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force's]] [[Special tactical unit|Special Tactical Unit]], a [[Special Weapons Team|tactical squad]] with the primary task of conducting operations against the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal syndicate. When the unit was tasked with aiding a [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]] in rescuing the Republic [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Eli Tarnis]] from the syndicate, they set up a perimeter around [[Black Sun Headquarters|Black Sun's headquarters]] in preparation for their upcoming [[Raid on the Black Sun headquarters|raid]].

==Biography==
The [[Republic soldier]] was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served with the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Assigned to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the soldier was part of the CSF's [[Special tactical unit|Special Tactical Unit]], a [[Special Weapons Team|tactical squad]] under the command of [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Nidaljo]] tasked with fighting back against the Coruscant-based [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal syndicate.<ref name="Rescue" /> By [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> the team had been operating deep in the [[Black Sun territory|gang's territory]] for several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] when they were tasked with aiding a [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]] in [[Raid on the Black Sun headquarters|rescuing]] the Republic [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Eli Tarnis]].<ref name="Rescue" />

{{GameLS}}
The unit was in the process of establishing a perimeter around Black Sun's [[Black Sun Headquarters|headquarters]] when the criminals attacked with high-grade weapons. Six members of the unit were [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the attack, and Officer [[Jorin]] was severely injured along with four others, forcing the unit to fall back behind a hastily-created barricade. Jorin succumbed to his injuries and died not long after the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] arrived, but the man's death helped the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] inspire Nidaljo and the rest of the unit to continue the fight and overwhelm Black Sun's forces.<ref name="Rescue" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Republic soldier appears in the [[BioWare]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', in the Jedi Knight class story mission "Rescue."<ref name="Rescue" />
